source_title: Mission UP: Amit Shah Arrives in Lucknow for 2027 Election Strategy Meeting
source_excerpt:
Union Home Minister Amit Shah is in Lucknow for the Uttar Pradesh BJP state working committee meeting, which party leaders are presenting as an important step in preparations for the 2027 Assembly elections. His arrival was reportedly delayed because of adverse weather conditions associated with Cyclone Arnab. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, both Deputy Chief Ministers and state BJP president Pankaj Chaudhary were among the leaders who received him. The meeting brings together approximately 2,850 BJP office-bearers and party workers. Leaders including Smriti Irani, Jitin Prasada, B. L. Verma and other senior functionaries were present at the venue. Party leaders said Shah’s address would provide guidance on the BJP’s electoral strategy, with messages expected to reach workers and voters through district-level and booth-level organisation. Several BJP leaders expressed confidence that the party would return to power in Uttar Pradesh in 2027, citing the leadership of Narendra Modi and Yogi Adityanath, organisational planning and workers’ efforts. One leader referred to Shah’s previous election strategies, while another predicted a strong majority for the BJP. The meeting comes amid political sparring, with Akhilesh Yadav reportedly questioning the BJP’s electoral performance. BJP leaders rejected the criticism and described the meeting as significant for the upcoming election.
